set.body:
Outcome

Remove rather than deprecate the architectural waist being replaced.

Acceptance

- PatternMatrix, PatternOperator, PatternSource, FeatureSet, FeatureSetPlan, Response, Fold, FoldPlan, RoiAnalysis, RoiPayload, RoiOutcome, MvpaEngine, MvpaStream, MvpaResult, MetricVector, and OneShotDataset are absent from live source.
- Proven kernels survive only behind new types.
- No legacy or next public namespace exists.
- No source-compatible shim remains.
set.title: P6.4: delete the legacy MVPA source and result ontology
